parameters.content:
## Real-Time Chatbot Integration

**Platforms:**
- Telegram Bot
- Slack Bot

**Features:**
- Command handling (/help, /status, etc.)
- AI-powered conversations (OpenAI GPT-4)
- Weather data integration
- News fetching
- Reminders
- Text analysis
- Interaction logging

**Commands:**
- /start - Welcome message
- /help - Show commands
- /status - System status
- /weather <city> - Weather info
- /news <topic> - Latest news
- /reminder <text> - Set reminder
- /analyze <text> - Text analysis

**AI Features:**
- Natural language understanding
- Context-aware responses
- Multi-turn conversations

**Setup:**
- Telegram Bot Token
- Slack App with Bot Token
- OpenAI API key
- Weather API key
- PostgreSQL database
